verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's docs describe an X-Set-Cookie header that forwards developer-supplied session cookies when fetching a URL, directly matching the story. However this is a single claimed-docs citation with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and community evidence shows unrelated auth/reliability issues (401 errors, 404s) that raise doubts about robustness. Missing for 10: independent verification that cookie-based authenticated fetches actually work end-to-end, and documentation depth (e.g., examples, session persistence details).
